name: app-backend
description: FastAPI backend for ASI-Telemetry metrics and traces with PostgreSQL storage.
author: Ujjwal Katiyar

scripts.test: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'), path = require('path'), fs = require('fs'); const py = fs.existsSync(path.join(__dirname, '.venv/Scripts/python.exe')) ? path.join(__dirname, '.venv/Scripts/python.exe') : 'python'; const child = spawn(py, ['-m', 'pytest', 'tests', '-v'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: false }); child.on('exit', (c) => process.exit(c ?? 0));"
